transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message: Hello, this is calling from our company. Is this a good time to talk about your account?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Um, hi... I mean, not really? I’m kind of busy at work right now. Can you maybe call back later? Or, like, send something in the mail?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.message:
Hi, and thank you for picking up—I really appreciate you taking a moment, even if you're busy. This is Sarah from ClearPath Financial Solutions, and I’m sorry to catch you in the middle of your workday. I completely understand how hectic things can get.

Of course, I can call you back at a better time or send information in the mail—whichever you'd prefer. I just want to make sure we’re on the same page and that you’re not stressed about this. 

Would you be able to let me know a good time to reach you later? Or if you’d rather not take calls, I can switch to mailing you the details and include a self-addressed envelope so it’s easy to respond. Either way, I’m here to help make this as simple and low-pressure as possible.

How would you feel most comfortable moving forward?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.message: Oh, um… yeah, maybe just mail it? I don’t really have time to talk later either—my schedule’s kind of all over. Just send it, and I’ll… I’ll look at it for sure. I promise. I’ve been meaning to get things sorted.
